newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 2.33 bln Ffr OATs after auction.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 2.33 bln Ffr OATs after auction.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold a further 2.332 billion francs of OATs after Thursday's auction, increasing the total nominal value of bonds sold to 24.168 billion francs. Following are the final results:

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 20 to 22 billion francs of OATs in total. The overall bid to cover ratio of the auction was 1.8.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
